representation.name: Scanpy Seurat HVG Jaccard
representation.description: Compute HVG Jaccard similarity on exact common var_names
representation.shell_command:
python - "$(inputs.adata1.path)" "$(inputs.adata2.path)" <<'PY'
import sys
import math
import scanpy as sc
import pandas as pd

a = sc.read_h5ad(sys.argv[1])
b = sc.read_h5ad(sys.argv[2])

common_b = set(b.var_names.tolist())
common = [g for g in a.var_names.tolist() if g in common_b]

def emit_nan(reason):
    with open("result.txt", "w") as out:
        out.write("answer\tNaN\n")
        out.write("reason\t" + reason + "\n")
        out.write("common_genes\t" + str(len(common)) + "\n")
    raise SystemExit(0)

if not common:
    emit_nan("no_common_genes")
if not a.var_names.is_unique or not b.var_names.is_unique:
    emit_nan("nonunique_var_names")

a = a[:, common].copy()
b = b[:, common].copy()

if "gene_symbols" in a.var.columns:
    a = a[:, ~pd.isna(a.var["gene_symbols"]).to_numpy()].copy()
if "gene_symbols" in b.var.columns:
    b = b[:, ~pd.isna(b.var["gene_symbols"]).to_numpy()].copy()

if a.n_vars == 0 or b.n_vars == 0:
    emit_nan("no_genes_after_allowed_missing_gene_symbols_exclusion")

sc.pp.highly_variable_genes(a, flavor="seurat")
sc.pp.highly_variable_genes(b, flavor="seurat")

accepted = ("True", "1", "TRUE")
hvg_a = {
    gene for gene, flag in zip(a.var_names.tolist(), a.var["highly_variable"].tolist())
    if str(flag) in accepted
}
hvg_b = {
    gene for gene, flag in zip(b.var_names.tolist(), b.var["highly_variable"].tolist())
    if str(flag) in accepted
}
intersection = hvg_a.intersection(hvg_b)
union = hvg_a.union(hvg_b)

if not union:
    answer = float("nan")
else:
    answer = len(intersection) / len(union)

with open("result.txt", "w") as out:
    out.write("answer\t" + ("NaN" if math.isnan(answer) else f"{answer:.2f}") + "\n")
    out.write("scanpy_version\t" + sc.__version__ + "\n")
    out.write("common_genes\t" + str(len(common)) + "\n")
    out.write("adata1_analyzed_genes\t" + str(a.n_vars) + "\n")
    out.write("adata2_analyzed_genes\t" + str(b.n_vars) + "\n")
    out.write("adata1_hvg\t" + str(len(hvg_a)) + "\n")
    out.write("adata2_hvg\t" + str(len(hvg_b)) + "\n")
    out.write("hvg_intersection\t" + str(len(intersection)) + "\n")
    out.write("hvg_union\t" + str(len(union)) + "\n")
    out.write("jaccard_unrounded\t" + ("NaN" if math.isnan(answer) else repr(answer)) + "\n")
PY
